 Rams MUST explore signing Odell Beckham Jr
 It is now or never for a potential reunion with Odell Beckham Jr and the Rams…
 by Steven Ridings Nov 10, 2026, 10:48 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The Los Angeles Rams should waste little time exploring the possibility of bringing Odell Beckham Jr. back to Los Angeles. With Beckham recently released from the Minnesota Vikings’ roster and reportedly expected to return to their practice squad, the Rams should at least kick the tires on a potential reunion.
 Beckham already knows Sean McVay’s offensive system, understands the expectations inside the building, and has a history with both McVay and general manager Les Snead. The two enjoyed having Beckham in Los Angeles, and his contributions during the Rams’ Super Bowl run in 2021 showed what he could bring to the offense.
 Sure, Beckham might not have the same tread on his tires that he once did. Nobody is expecting him to return as the superstar receiver who took the league by storm in New York. However, the Rams don’t necessarily need that version of Beckham. They need another experienced receiver who can provide a legitimate alternative when defenses focus their attention on the remaining playmakers. Matthew Stafford can trust that Odell Beckham Jr can be in the spot that he needs to be.
 At this stage, Beckham would represent a clear upgrade over the likes of Jordan Whittington and Konata Mumpfield. With Los Angeles needing additional help at receiver, there is little reason not to explore a reunion with a familiar face who could still have something left in the tank.
